source: BBOC 2025 Sun Belt East + West Betting Preview (Mike Calabrese/Collin Wilson/Josh 'Duck' Nunn)

teams.qb_status: Battle — Matthew Sluka (UNLV) / Alonzo Barnett III (health)
teams.key_avoids: Draws the three good East teams (Georgia Southern, Old Dominion, App State) ALL at home in Harrisonburg; hosts Louisiana from the West; only tough conf road is at Texas State. Non-con: at Louisville (wk2), at Liberty, home Wazzu. 13-1 to make the CFP.
teams.key_injury: QB Alonzo Barnett III — returning from injury (Chesney optimistic)
teams.bboc_notes: The clear conference favorite and all three hosts' pick to win the Sun Belt (Collin projects 9.3, well over 8.5). The Sluka–Chesney reunion is the headline — no play-caller in the last five years dialed up more designed-QB runs than Chesney, tailor-made for Sluka's legs (the UNLV blueprint to shrink games). Three-headed QB room (Sluka, Barnett returning, Richmond transfer Camden Coleman) is huge G5 depth. Best portal class in the G5 (28 three-stars); loses edge/LB playmakers but grabbed Alabama co-DC Colin Hitschler (takeaway specialist). All three like JMU to WIN THE EAST (+110) and value the 3-1 conference title. Duck/Collin prefer a wk2 money line at Louisville over the 13-1 CFP future. Only pause: the new-look DL vs heavy rushing attacks.

teams.key_avoids: Daunting non-con (at Indiana, Virginia Tech, at Liberty — likely losses) then softens. Winnable conf roadies at Marshall + at ULM; home vs Coastal, App State, Troy, Georgia State. Coastal + Marshall in back-to-back weeks (both off byes), then back-to-back travel to JMU.
teams.bboc_notes: All three positive on the Monarchs; Collin projects 6.5 and leans OVER 5.5 but hates the -200 juice (would rather wait for a 6). Two potential player-of-the-year candidates: MLB Jason Henderson (139 tackles from the all-time FBS record, back from injury — lifts the run D) and dual-threat QB Colton 'Kojo' Joseph (22 TD in 8 starts, led the nation in red-zone scoring %). All-senior OL, both tackles back (26th in line yards). Concerns: Kojo's 6 BTT to 20 turnover-worthy plays + fumbles; an unproven, possibly worst-in-the-Belt secondary; zero returning WR production. 7 one-possession losses in 2024 drive the preseason love — the arrow points up, likely a bowl team, but the sloppiness caps the ceiling below JMU.

teams.key_avoids: Could start 0-2 on back-to-back West Coast trips (at Fresno State, at USC). Draws Arkansas State from the West. Projected ~2-TD dog at James Madison. Hedge spot for an under: wk3 vs Jacksonville State (hosts see JSU as weak).
teams.bboc_notes: Collin + Duck both UNDER 7.5 (Collin projects 6.6). Possibly the best QB/RB/WR combo in the Belt — JC French (17:17 TD:INT before the bowl), 79 returning OL starts (most in the conference), slot Josh Dallas (2.1 YPRR). But it's a backwards roster: a strong, experienced SECONDARY and a leaky front seven — Collin expects opponents to run for ~8 YPC and force shootouts (the Boise/Genty game as the template). French's 20 turnover-worthy plays (3rd-highest pressure read in the Belt) scare both. Duck sees a 2-4 start (two West Coast trips) needing a rally; thinks they were lucky in ~3 wins in 2024, so the number is elevated. 6-6/7-5 range. Applin's dink-and-dunk offense may add 12-personnel/tight-end usage.

teams.qb_status: Battle — Emmett Brown / Tad Hudson (UNC) / MJ Morris (Maryland)
teams.key_avoids: Opens vs Virginia; good bye before Old Dominion. Brutal November — at Georgia Southern, at South Carolina (out of a back-to-back), close at hosting James Madison. Hosts see only two games favored by a FG+.
teams.bboc_notes: A FADE — Collin projects 3.7, well under 5.5 (in the app), and Duck leans under too. QB is a three-way mess (MJ Morris from Maryland — never put it together at multiple P4 stops; Tad Hudson from UNC; likely Emmett Brown) behind 69 returning OL starts, but they switched concepts mid-2024 and were ineffective. The DEFENSE is fully depleted (line + secondary) — excellent new DC Jeremiah Johnson (built the Louisiana Tech D) has publicly said they'll play vanilla base/cover-1 'until we figure out who our players are,' so no early havoc. Poor coaching indicators: 38% on 3rd down, 9 empty red-zone trips + 10 red-zone FGs. A bowl would require everything to go right; 4-8 or 5-7 more likely.

teams.key_avoids: Toughest conference slate — road games at Old Dominion AND at James Madison. Good situational spot off a bye vs Boise State (between Air Force and Notre Dame) but not a win. Gets some bottom-feeders (Charlotte, Marshall, Arkansas State, Coastal, Georgia State) and FCS Lindenwood.
teams.bboc_notes: Arrow pointing DOWN — new HC Dowell Loggains brings a 'let the QB make plays when it breaks down' philosophy (Collin's critique) replacing App's traditional power-run identity, and a drop in QB play (AJ Swann from Vandy / big JJ Kohl). Lowest returning OL starts in the Belt (22). Potentially the worst DL in the conference vs the run (129th in rushing success rate in 2024); DC DJ Smith unproven to fix it; the secondary was among the least disruptive in the country. Collin projects 5.2 (just under 5.5, juiced the right way — leans under). Duck notes the schedule lacks aerial killers, so they may muck up a couple. 4-5 wins likely; a bowl needs everything to break right. 'We're going to find out what rock bottom is.'

teams.key_avoids: BOAT-RACE WATCH — Thursday Oct 23 hosting South Alabama on 5 days' rest after a road trip to Georgia Southern (Duck projects S. Alabama ~-9). Sees a 1-4 start. Beat Vanderbilt + Texas State (as a 21-pt dog) in 2024.
teams.bboc_notes: Duck drove this one; a soft FADE lean. Best recruiting class in the Belt (six three-star WRs, six three-star linemen) and quality RB portal adds (Rashad Amos ex-Miami-OH, Jordan Simmons) — but the portal ignored a defense that was very bad vs the run (5.2 YPC allowed, eight 200-yard rushing games). New OC Hugh Jackson (from the NFL) is migrating them to a slow, pro-style, tight-end-heavy attack that may not fit QB Christian Veilleux — a schematic gamble. Secondary is a full rebuild (torchable on play-action). Duck sees 3-4 wins, no bowl, positive long-term trajectory but 'a year or so away.' Collin flatly 'does not care' at 39-1 to win the Belt.

teams.qb_status: Battle — Carlos Del Rio-Wilson / Zion Turner
teams.key_avoids: Opens at Georgia (bug-meets-windshield), then Missouri State + Eastern Kentucky to sort out the offense. Home conf slate brutal (ODU, Texas State, James Madison, Georgia Southern all visit); winnable games are on the road (at Louisiana, at Coastal); at App State late. ~7 of last 8 games project within a TD.
teams.bboc_notes: A YEAR-ZERO rebuild after a Sun Belt title — the administration flubbed the Charles Huff situation and Southern Miss poached him, his staff, and a mass exodus of players. HOST SPLIT on how to bet it: Collin makes them 5.5 and by juice should take the over (+140) but PASSES — 'I don't know what I'm getting until I get three games in' — while Duck went UNDER 5.5 early (projects a team ~12 points worse than 2024, 3-9/4-8). New HC Tony Gibson brings his respected NC State 3-3-5 but the talent (esp. WRs, ~2 dozen OL starts, RB-by-committee, new OC Rod Smith's Rich-Rod scheme) may not meet it. Duck would take under 2.5 at +550/+600 for the true implosion case. Massive uncertainty; the identity is unknown until ~game 4.

teams.qb_status: Battle — Kaldrick Luster (SMU) / Brad Jackson / Nate Yarnell
teams.key_avoids: September to figure out the QB: Eastern Michigan, Nicholls, at UTSA, at Arizona State (Sept 13, a spot ASU may not care about). Draws James Madison from the East (home, Oct 28). UTSA road is a possible loss.
teams.bboc_notes: Co-favorite in the West (7-1) but both PASS the win total (Colin projects 7.1). You're purely betting GJ Kinne's balanced, GG-flavored system — lost EVERY offensive starter, so the QB battle (SMU transfer Kaldrick Luster may beat incumbent Brad Jackson) and elite C Tellek Lockett are the keys. 115th in returning production. Top-3 tacklers back on a 4-2-5 (good run-stop), but the back seven bleeds explosives (106th coverage, 118th passing-downs explosive) — a boom-or-bust, outscore-you profile. Untimely turnovers directly cost them the Arizona State/Louisiana/Georgia State games in 2024 — which is why who wins the QB job (dual-threat + ball security) matters. Duck: it does matter.

teams.qb_status: Transfer — Walker Howard (from Ole Miss/LSU; first year starting)
teams.key_avoids: Two layups to open (Rice, McNeese) to settle Howard in. One of the easiest SOS in the Belt; hosts rivals Texas State + Southern Miss; South Alabama on 6-days' rest (the one tricky spot); BYE before at James Madison (a possible Sun Belt title preview). Non-con loss at Missouri.
teams.bboc_notes: Co-favorite in the West and Mike's over pick — 'Howard or bust.' Walker Howard is the most talented QB recruit in program history (ESPN's #1 dual-threat) who simply sat behind Jayden Daniels/Nussmeier at LSU then Jackson Dart at Ole Miss — no shame, no read on his intangibles. Michael Desormeaux's staff turned Ben Wooldridge into a star; the run game (Zylan Perry, Bill Davis, both 3.7+ YAC) remains Billy-Napier-DNA good, but the WR room is green (needs Shelton Sampson Jr). The wet blanket is the DEFENSE — lost 10 of the top-13 tacklers, and DC Jim Salgado's 2024 unit was bottom-130s nearly everywhere (132nd rush-success, 125th contested-catch, 131st pass-rush, 124th tackling). The slow tempo (117th) forces the D to get a stop. Colin 7.4 (no play), Mike over.

teams.key_avoids: Mississippi State opener (probable loss), then FOUR straight winnable (Jackson State, etc.) — a chance to bank the over early. The West decider is at Louisiana (Oct 18). Closes with App State, Arkansas State, Texas State, South Alabama, Troy — all winnable.
teams.bboc_notes: THE worse-to-first / dark-horse play — Mike's favorite G5 over (4.5) and a 30-1 future (Colin bought 40-1; all three all-in). The whole Marshall program moved south: HC Charles Huff poached Marshall's QB Braylon Braxton (19:2 TD:INT, undefeated as a starter), five of eleven D starters, and DC Jason Seymour — then added OC Blake Anderson (elite Arkansas State/Utah State play-caller, career resuscitated after the USU firing/lawsuit). 54 portal additions (best in the G5). The market is pricing the helmet sticker after an 0-fer 2024 conference slate; but 2024 was -19 turnover margin (dead last, 'should've' been -8) — regression toward 0 alone is a massive swing. LB Michael Montgomery a dog. Get the future before the power ratings adjust after ~4 games.

teams.key_avoids: The winnable games are ALL on the road (Southeast Missouri, at Kennesaw, at ULM, at Troy, at App State) — 4 road games needed for 5 wins; the home conf slate is brutal (Texas State, Georgia Southern, Southern Miss, Louisiana all visit Jonesboro, several off byes). Paycheck losses at Arkansas + Iowa State.
teams.bboc_notes: A FADE — all three under 5.5 (Colin projects 3.7). They somehow kept the big three (QB Jaylen Raynor, WRs Corey Rucker + Chauncey Baucham) so the offense can be good, but the OL returns ONE starter (33 starts) and the tempo is 17th-fastest — Raynor will have to sling it or take off. The huge tell is regression: 6-0 in one-possession games in 2024 (and Duck argues several wins they didn't deserve — Central Arkansas, Tulsa, South Alabama). The defense is rebuilt to possibly the worst DL + secondary in the Belt (19 sacks, 5.7 YPC, new 4-2-5 under Griff McCarley). Butch Jones has never gone well for backers late. Under 5.5 (and under 4.5 on alts).

teams.key_avoids: Non-con losses at Tulane + Auburn; at Troy on a back-to-back; the last two (Southern Miss, Texas State) are strong. Six games Colin makes them ~a TD favorite (Coastal, Morgan State, Georgia State road bat-spot, etc.).
teams.bboc_notes: HOST SPLIT — Duck UNDER 6.5 (the portal losses are massive), Colin OVER-lean (projects ~7.4, waiting for a 6.5). Lost QB Gio Lopez (UNC), RB Fluff Bothwell (Miss St), WR Jamaal Pritchett, and all three levels of the D (23 portal adds that don't match the talent lost). New OC Paul Petrino runs a slow, balanced pro-style that Duck thinks doesn't fit the skill set (already-poor situational offense, 38% on 3rd down). Colin counters: RB Kentrell Bullock has good numbers, the OL returns 52 starts (52nd), and Bishop Davenport looked excellent in the bowl (may beat Minnesota transfer Zach Pyron). Major Applewhite always gets to 7-8 wins. Colin wants Davenport named QB1 before firing the over.

teams.key_avoids: Wins over Nicholls, clear loss at Clemson (that DL eats the Troy OL), tough at Memphis — check the roster's health after Sept 14. Roughly 10 toss-up games; only Nicholls + Georgia State project as double-digit favorites.
teams.key_injury: Goose Crowder — battled injuries in 2024; health is the season
teams.bboc_notes: A pass for all three on the win total (Colin projects ~6.0 but wants to see health after Clemson/Memphis; Duck isolates CONFERENCE wins OVER 3.5 as the better bet). Gerad Parker's rocky 2024 ended 3-1 with elite situational stats (top-10 in 3rd down + red zone — a coaching sign). But they must replace weapons around Goose Crowder — losing WR Devonte Ross (Penn State) + LT Daniel King (UNC, keeps Goose upright) hurts. The roster's three of the top-five players are at LB/DB — the defense is the strength (19th in returning production, top-20 D). High variance (~10 toss-ups); back them from Sept 20 on if healthy.

teams.key_avoids: Saint Francis (FCS win), at Northwestern (a possible cover); winnable UTEP off a bye, Arkansas State on back-to-back travel, ODU at home. Slow 133rd-tempo, ball-control keep-away.
teams.bboc_notes: Lean over (Colin projects 5.5, over 4.5; Duck sees 4-5 and prefers in-game unders). The huge loss is RB Ahmad 'A-Mod' Hardy — replaced by Brayln McReynolds (South Alabama). 24th in returning production (15th on D). Bryan Vincent has elevated ULM 'from complete futility to a real opponent' (beat JMU as a 16-pt dog in 2024 — coaching). The pass D is actually the strength (can bother the sling-it offenses on the slate); the run D was 134th in rush-success (JUCOs plugging holes). Question marks: who calls the plays (Vincent says not him), developing QB Aiden Armenta, and the Hunter Herring wildcat. 2024 badly overperformed (opened at a 1.5 win total). Colin over 5.5.
